alternative_explanations: Any apparent gain may be ordinary shrinkage from a pooled linear prior, finite-sample regularization, closed-loop trajectory similarity or controller artifacts rather than transferable fault dynamics.
confounds: Invalidate on any condition, trajectory, speed, drone, repetition, timestamp, path, filename, hash, test target or privileged-support access; train/test window overlap; post-score tuning; baseline semantic mismatch; state-budget breach; corpus mismatch; or evaluator digest change.

invalidation_rules: Invalidate on any archive, file-manifest, split-manifest, raw MAT or numeric-payload hash mismatch.
Invalidate if any implementable candidate receives a source name, path, factor label, trajectory, speed, drone, repetition, timestamp or condition ID.
Invalidate if any file or history/target window crosses train, validation, test, OOD or privileged-oracle-support roles.
Invalidate if any candidate-visible feature reads outside the frozen adaptation boundary or if evaluation targets reach fit/adaptation.
Invalidate if normalization, rank, ridge, horizons, anchors, thresholds or baseline semantics change after scoring output.
Invalidate if a mandatory baseline hash or conformance test fails before runner seed realization.
Invalidate on post-score tuning, external model/API use, state-budget breach or evaluator-integrity change.

falsification_criteria: Discard this exact learner if its preregistered semantic fixture fails or changes under anonymous flight permutation; if either minimum condition or trajectory transfer gain is non-positive; if oracle-gap closure is non-positive; if rollouts are non-finite; or if a simpler implementable control Pareto-dominates it.

outcome_policy.negative: A candidate crash or numeric failure rejects only this implementation; leakage, semantic-control, corpus, seed, budget or integrity failure invalidates the experiment and contributes no scientific evidence.
outcome_policy.null: A valid null discards this exact rank-12 operator-subspace learner without tuning rank, ridge, history, anchors, split, horizons, thresholds or budgets against the observed seed.
outcome_policy.positive: A valid one-seed positive supports only that this fixed low-rank representation merits unchanged multi-seed replication on the same real cohort; it does not establish cross-benchmark transfer, a scaling law or an LLM successor.

predicted_outcome: The unchanged shared rank-12 learner may lower 1/10/50 NRMSE in every held-out condition and trajectory relative to independent and no-sharing ARX while retaining finite rollouts and positive oracle-gap closure; strong contextual Chow-Liu and empirical-joint controls may instead dominate after full cost.
promotion_criteria: Quick cannot promote. One valid seed with positive condition and trajectory transfer, positive oracle-gap closure, finite rollouts and implementable Pareto non-dominance may authorize only an unchanged three-seed screen with the same rank, split, anchors, horizons, thresholds and controls.
research_question: Can one unchanged rank-12 operator-subspace learner transfer controlled dynamics to unseen fault-severity and trajectory worlds with better quality per fully charged cost than independent, pooled, probabilistic and privileged controls?
title: Shared rank-12 operator-subspace transfer on unseen DronePropA worlds (corrected v5 test)
